records.text: Were told that they needed to cut ties with her. It had become too risky. And so they did. And it devastated her. Coming after a year of erratic behavior where she'd barely gotten through the shoot of The Misfits, being dumped by the Kennedys sent her into a tailspin.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
